messages:
nxu: Heads-up — I'm proposing a small RBAC addition: an ephemeral 'deployer' role that CI runners can assume for releases. Purpose: narrow privileges + tied to 1-hour KMS decrypt token and mandatory audit logging. Thoughts?

ajohnson: sounds reasonable. key questions: how do we create the ephemeral KMS grants and ensure audit logs show the original actor (CI job id) and not just the runner service account?

maria: +1 on ephemeral. We tried ephemeral tokens for database migration last quarter; main pain was agent clocks and token refresh. Also need a clear revoke path if a release is paused.

sec-bot: SAST alert: recent PR #421 in repo 'redwood-core' added a write permission to kms:Decrypt in terraform module ci-runner. Marked HIGH risk. Link: https://scans.redwood/sec/421

nxu: @sec-bot noted. The plan: CI job uses short-lived credential to call sts:AssumeRole(deployer), that role has kms:Decrypt for specific key alias/ARN and iam:PassRole blocked. Audit pipeline must log: assumeRole call, KMS decrypt call, resource id, and CI job id as principal.

devex-liz: can we put a policy example in the thread? helps approvals.

nxu: sure — draft policy below (pseudo-terraform/iam):

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ephemeral-deployer",
      "Condition": {"NumericLessThanEquals": {"aws:EpochTime": "<expiry>"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

nxu: and role trust for ephemeral-deployer:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-runner"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```

ajohnson: small nit: aws:EpochTime in condition is nonstandard; prefer aws:TokenIssueTime or use session duration limit in AssumeRole. Also lock down source IP or GitHub Actions OIDC sub claim to repo/job.

maria: on the audit side — we need to enrich KMS logs with the CI metadata. Suggest adding the job id as a KMS request tag (if provider supports) or put the job id into the assumeRole session name and surface that in CloudTrail/KMS logs.

sre_oncall: for incident readiness, add automatic revocation: if a high-severity SAST/DAST fails during a deploy, CI should call an orchestration API to revoke the role session (we can set up an allowlist service to revoke sessions by id). Also alert paging channel.

devex-liz: who owns the allowlist service? I can help with a small Lambda + Dynamo prototype if sec agrees.

nxu: ownership: security owns the policy & audit requirements, devex owns developer-friendly tooling (Lambda prototype), infra owns role lifecycle. Suggest we create a short RFC and a runbook.

ajohnson: RFC must include: explicit SAST/DAST gating rules, token lifetime (max 1 hour), emergency revoke path, audit fields to collect (assumeRole sessionName, requestID, keyID, ci-job-id), and an example incident play: "SAST fail during release -> revoke session -> rollback -> postmortem".

sec-bot: CI check failing: SAST JOB - redwood-core - block on kms:Decrypt in terraform.

maria: Action items: 1) nxu to draft RFC + Terraform sample for ephemeral-deployer role and restricted KMS policy. 2) devex-liz to prototype revoke API. 3) ia (infra) to validate CloudTrail visibility for AssumeRole+kms decrypt. 4) ajohnson to update SAST rule to detect wide kms grants in PRs.

nxu: I'll post RFC today. For SAST rule, ajohnson can you prioritize? This GH PR is blocking a release.

ajohnson: on it. I'll add a suppression only after we have the ephemeral role pattern documented.

devex-liz: prototype ETA 3 days.

sre_oncall: I'll craft the incident step in the oncall playbook and wire the alert to #oncall-release.

maria: one last thing — check KMS key rotation implications. If key rotates, existing session decrypts should continue, but reuses will use new key version; confirm with KMS team.

nxu: good call. I'll add a KMS rotation compatibility check in RFC.

devex-liz: :thumbsup:

ajohnson: thanks everyone — seems safe to block the PR for now until we have the pattern enforced.

nxu: thanks, will follow up with RFC link.
